thread:
maya: Quick UX review for compact summary in eval-run when multiple diffs selected. Mock: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE-compact-summary. Main asks: accessible counts, clear copy, and no focus traps.

ravi: Love the compact summary. Two nitpicks: 1) use pluralization: '3 items' vs '1 item'. 2) make the regression indicator a pill with aria-label = '1 regression'.

elle: Keyboard: after selecting diffs, keyboard users need to be able to open the summary with Enter and close with Escape. Don't trap focus inside the summary panel.

maya: Good call. Proposal: summary is a lightweight banner (role='status') that can be expanded; default not focus-trapped. When expanded it becomes dialog with role='dialog' and focus managed.

tony: Copy suggestion for banner: "3 items selected — 1 regression. Review diffs or approve." Button text: 'Review diffs' and 'Approve selected'. Avoid 'changes'.

a11ybot: Automated checks: ensure regression pill color passes 3:1 contrast with white text. If using red (#ef4444) consider bold text. Add aria-live='polite' on the banner so screen readers announce count updates.

ravi: Also ensure screen-reader text when expanding: "Summary expanded. Press Escape to close."

elle: Micro-interaction: when user selects via keyboard the banner should appear but not steal focus; pressing 's' when banner visible should toggle expansion. Add `aria-expanded` on the toggle.

maya: Decisions: use pluralization, banner role='status' with aria-live, expansion turns into dialog with focus trap, button copy per tony, keyboard 's' toggles expansion, a11y fixes per bot. Action items: ravi update aria labels; elle implement keyboard + focus; tony update copy; a11ybot to re-run check after PR. Sync tomorrow 9:30am PT.

ravi: I'll open a small PR for aria changes and tests.

maya: Thanks all :white_check_mark:
